outputs.explanation: The Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW plots show mean ± S.D. bars/lines with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each mouse (n=5 per group).
Panel B shows representative gross photographs of mice, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C shows representative H&E and Oil Red O staining micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D shows dot blot images (5mC and methylene blue staining), which is a blot, not a plot of averaged data.
The bar chart quantifying 5mC/Methylene Blue ratio displays individual data points (dots) for each sample overlaid on the bars, for both NC and HFD groups.
The bottom bar chart quantifying TET1, TET2, TET3/GAPDH ratios shows individual data points (dots/squares) overlaid on the bars for each biological replicate.
